verdict.rationale: CRA documents EFILE as a sanctioned system-to-system transmitter channel. Software developers go through a CRA certification process, and enrolled electronic filers transmit client returns (and ReFILE amendments) directly from certified software. Filers manage, renew and view transmission history with an EFILE number and password, and the agency's own pages publish the enrollment path. Missing for 10: the enrollment steps themselves are not quoted in detail; evidence covers only individual T1 returns, not system channels for other programs such as payroll or GST/HST batch filing; no technical transmission specs; no independent or hands-on corroboration.
